name: memory
description: Persistent agent memory and consolidation for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Remember, recall, and consolidate knowledge in a track vault.
interface.longDescription: Memory stores durable facts as tagged track notes so agents keep knowledge across sessions, and the dream skill consolidates them: merging duplicates, resolving contradictions, and pruning stale entries with generation-based revert.
interface.defaultPrompt: Recall relevant memory before this task and record any durable facts you learn.
